description: This file defines the SecurityGroup class, extending SecurityGroup_sugar, and provides methods for managing security groups, their relationships to records and users, inheritance logic, and related operations within the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: SecurityGroup
classes.description: Represents a security group with methods for managing group memberships, relationships to records and users, inheritance, and permissions within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getGroupWhere
methods.description: Returns a SQL WHERE clause for retrieving records the user has group rights to.

methods.name: getGroupUsersWhere
methods.description: Returns a SQL WHERE clause for retrieving users in the same groups as the given user.

methods.name: getGroupJoin
methods.description: Returns SQL JOIN statement to include security group data in record queries.

methods.name: getGroupUsersJoin
methods.description: Returns SQL JOIN statement for including users in the same groups in queries.

methods.name: groupHasAccess
methods.description: Checks if the security group has access to a specific record and action.

methods.name: inherit
methods.description: Handles inheritance of security groups for a record, including default, creator, parent, and assignment inheritance.

methods.name: assign_default_groups
methods.description: Assigns default security groups to a new record.

methods.name: inherit_creator
methods.description: Inherits security groups from the creator of the record.

methods.name: inherit_assigned
methods.description: Inherits security groups from the assigned user.

methods.name: inherit_parent
methods.description: Inherits security groups from related parent records.

methods.name: inherit_parentQuery
methods.description: Executes SQL to inherit security groups from a parent record.

methods.name: inheritOne
methods.description: Inherits a group when user belongs to only one inheritable group.

methods.name: getMembershipCount
methods.description: Returns the number of inheritable security groups a user belongs to.

methods.name: retrieveDefaultGroups
methods.description: Fetches default security groups for use in inheritance.

methods.name: saveDefaultGroup
methods.description: Saves a security group as a default for a module.

methods.name: removeDefaultGroup
methods.description: Removes a default security group setting.

methods.name: getSecurityModules
methods.description: Returns modules associated with security groups (for inheritance and default assignment).

methods.name: getLinkName
methods.description: Retrieves the relationship link name between modules.

methods.name: addGroupToRecord
methods.description: Associates a security group with a specific record.

methods.name: removeGroupFromRecord
methods.description: Removes a security group association from a record.

methods.name: getUserSecurityGroups
methods.description: Returns the list of security groups a user belongs to.

methods.name: getAllSecurityGroups
methods.description: Returns all active security groups.

methods.name: getMembers
methods.description: Lists all active users in this security group.

methods.name: getPrimaryGroupID
methods.description: Gets current user's primary security group.

methods.name: getParentGroups
methods.description: Lists parent security groups for a record.

methods.name: getRecordGroups
methods.description: Retrieves security groups associated with a specific record.

methods.name: getParentBean
methods.description: Fetches the parent bean object given parent id and type.
